feat: Implement IMDb scraping, redesign Profile screen, and enhance UI
This commit introduces a comprehensive metadata scraping system using IMDb, a complete redesign of the Profile screen with advanced analytics, and significant UI/UX enhancements across the application.
**IMDb Metadata Scraping & Content Enrichment:** * **Deep Scraping Engine:** Implemented a robust, multi-stage scraping system (`ImdbScraper`, `RetrofitClient`) to fetch rich metadata for movies and series. * **Phase 1 (Instant):** Uses the IMDb suggestion API for a "light speed" initial discovery to immediately fetch title, poster, and cast. * **Phase 2 (Background):** Incrementally scrapes and populates detailed information including full plot summaries, user reviews, content ratings (e.g., PG-13, 18+), parental guidance warnings (violence, horror), awards, Metascore, and high-resolution cast member images. * **Dynamic UI Updates:** The `DetailScreen` now updates incrementally as new metadata (plot, cast, reviews) is scraped in the background, providing a progressively richer user experience. * **New Settings:** Added toggles in the settings to enable/disable IMDb scraping and automatic download cover scraping. * **Trailer & Cast Display:** * The `DetailScreen` now displays a "Trailer" button that opens the official trailer on YouTube. * A new horizontal carousel displays cast members with their profile pictures.
**Profile Screen Redesign & Analytics:** * **Complete Overhaul:** Replaced the old profile layout with a modern, data-rich, and responsive `LazyVerticalGrid`. * **Advanced Statistics:** The `ProfileViewModel` now calculates and displays a wide range of new user statistics: * **Content Distribution:** A visual bar shows the ratio of movies, series, and live TV watched. * **User Level:** A gamified level (e.g., "Newbie 🌱", "Binge Master 👑") is assigned based on total watch time. * **Analytics Cards:** New cards display average session time, content completion rate, and count of unfinished items. * **Responsive Layout:** The grid layout automatically adjusts the number of columns based on screen width for optimal viewing on phones and tablets. * **Flat & Expressive Design:** Migrated to a flatter, card-based design using `MaterialTheme.colorScheme.surfaceContainer` for a cleaner aesthetic.
**UI/UX and Player Enhancements:** * **Expressive Carousels:** * Replaced `LazyRow` on the `HomeScreen` with `HorizontalMultiBrowseCarousel` for a more modern, expressive feel. * A new "Featured" hero carousel is now displayed at the top of the Home screen. * **Player & History:** * Refactored player composables into a dedicated `ui.player` package. * Replaced `LinearProgressIndicator` with `LinearWavyProgressIndicator` in the "Continue Watching" row for a more dynamic look. * Added `minLines = 2` to all content cards to prevent text from jumping during image loading, improving layout stability. * **Downloads Screen Optimization:** * Refactored the `LazyColumn` to flatten the item structure, which improves performance and allows for more fluid entry animations. * Optimized Coil image loading requests with explicit sizing and global crossfade. * Removed toast notifications for scan results.
**Build & Technical Refinements:** * **Dependency Updates:** Added `android-youtube-player` and `jsoup` for trailer playback and web scraping. * **Repository Caching:** `XtreamRepository` now implements a file-based caching layer for movie, series, and live stream lists to improve performance and reduce network calls. * **ProGuard/R8:** Enabled full mode for R8 and added specific rules for `kotlinx.serialization` to ensure proper functionality in release builds. * **Localization:** Added new strings for the IMDb features and cleaned up existing localized strings.

refactor: Overhaul downloads, profile, and watch history management
This commit introduces a major refactoring of core features, replacing the old Room-based database with a more robust and reactive architecture.
**Key Changes:**
* **Downloads:** * Replaced the old download system with a new `DownloadManager` for better control over pausing, resuming, and canceling downloads. * Added support for different download algorithms (OkHttp, System Download Manager) and the ability to use VLC for downloading. * Enhanced the Downloads UI to show speed, time remaining, and provide controls for pause/resume/cancel. * Added a "Battery Optimization" setting to guide users for better background download performance.
* **Profile & Watch History:** * Replaced the old profile screen with a redesigned, modern UI. * Introduced profile name editing and profile picture selection from the gallery. * Separated "Continue Watching" from the full "Watch History". * Implemented a permanent "remove from continue watching" feature; items are only restored if watched again. * Improved watch time tracking to more accurately measure time spent watching, excluding seeking. * Added a dedicated Watch History screen.
* **Player & Playback:** * Fixed a critical bug causing the player slider to freeze during seeking. * Improved handling of local file playback for both ExoPlayer and LibVLC. * Enhanced the "Hybrid" player mode to automatically switch to VLC on ExoPlayer failure without a full activity restart. * Live stream progress is now saved to continue watching.
* **Technical & UI/UX:** * Replaced the Room database with `SharedPreferences` for managing watch history and profile settings, simplifying data persistence. * Migrated ViewModels to use `StateFlow` for a more reactive and modern UI architecture. * Added debouncing to the search functionality for a smoother user experience. * Updated the app version to 2.0.0 and added detailed release notes in the "About" section.

feat: Implement robust downloads, add localization, and enhance UI
This commit introduces significant features and refinements across the application.
**Downloads:** * **Sequential Season Downloads:** Implemented a new `downloadSeason` function in `DownloadManager` to download all episodes of a season sequentially with a 20ms delay between each to prevent network congestion. * **Robust File Cleanup:** Refactored download cancellation and deletion logic into a centralized `DownloadCleanupHelper`. This new helper prevents ghost files by deleting 0-byte files on pause/failure and ensures series/season folders are correctly removed only when empty. * **ProGuard Rules:** Added ProGuard rules for LibVLC to prevent crashes in release builds.
**Localization (i18n):** * **New Languages:** Added support for Spanish, German, French, Portuguese, and Russian. Language options in settings now include flag emojis. * **String Externalization:** Moved hardcoded strings from numerous activities and composables to `strings.xml` for full localization. This includes `DownloadsScreen`, `SettingsScreen`, `DetailScreen`, `HomeActivity`, `FavoritesScreen`, and more. * **Turkish Suffix Logic:** Corrected and localized the Turkish suffix logic for "resume from" timestamps in `DetailScreen`.
**UI/UX Enhancements:** * **Responsive Layouts:** * Search results and category views now use a responsive `LazyVerticalGrid` that adjusts the number of columns based on screen width. * `SettingsScreen` adapts its layout for narrow screens (<360dp) to prevent UI elements from overlapping. * Card aspect ratios in `HomeScreen` now adjust for tablet displays. * **Detail Screen:** The hero image height is now dynamic (55% of the screen height) for a more adaptive and visually appealing layout. * **UI Polish:** Removed the Turkish-specific `READMETR.md` in favor of a single, comprehensive `README.md`.

refactor: Move ViewModel factories to their respective ViewModel files
This commit refactors the `ViewModelProvider.Factory` implementations by moving them from separate files into companion objects or top-level objects within their corresponding ViewModel files. This improves code organization and co-location.
**Key Changes:** * **Factory Consolidation:** Deleted individual `ViewModelFactory` files. * **ViewModel Integration:** Moved factory logic directly into `HomeViewModel`, `DetailViewModel`, `SeriesDetailViewModel`, `SearchViewModel`, `FavoritesViewModel`, and `SettingsViewModel`. * **Hilt/DI Preparation:** This change simplifies the codebase and prepares for a future migration to a dependency injection framework like Hilt.
**Download System Enhancements:** * **Improved Stall Detection:** The download speed monitor now calculates speed based on byte delta over time, allowing it to detect stalls even when `onProgress` callbacks stop. It also starts monitoring earlier (at 1% progress). * **Downloads Screen UI:** * Implemented a unified timeline that sorts all downloads (movies and series groups) by active status and then by date, keeping related content together. * Movies now display larger, portrait-style thumbnails. * **Resume Playback:** Downloads can now be resumed from their last watched position.
**UI and UX Refinements:** * **Detail Screen:** Redesigned the Play/Download button layout to be responsive, using a vertical arrangement on smaller phone screens. * **Settings Screen:** Updated the title to use a Material 3 expressive chip for a cleaner look. * **General UI:** Fixed various minor UI bugs, including text overflow issues and animation glitches. * **Translations:** Added new strings and updated existing ones for multiple languages.

refactor: Enhance downloads, player, and adopt Material 3 Expressive
This commit introduces a major overhaul of the download system, significant player enhancements, and a migration to Material 3 Expressive components for a more modern UI.
**Downloads System Overhaul:** * **File Scanner & Importer:** * Implemented a robust local file scanner (`scanExistingDownloads`) that automatically detects and imports existing movie and series files into the downloads library. * The scanner intelligently parses filenames to extract titles, years, and content types (Movie/Episode). * Supports scanning custom download folders selected by the user via the system's folder picker, with permission handling for Android 11+. * Includes a pruning mechanism to remove database entries for files that no longer exist. * **Automatic Cover Scraper:** * Downloads with missing cover art now automatically trigger a scraper that searches OMDB/IMDB for the correct poster and downloads it. * The scraper uses intelligent title cleaning and multiple search attempts for better accuracy. * Downloaded covers are saved locally next to the media files. * **UI/UX Redesign:** * Replaced linear progress bars with new `CircularWavyProgressIndicator` and `LinearWavyProgressIndicator` for a more dynamic look. * Redesigned series group cards to be larger, show total folder size, and use a cleaner layout. * Individual download cards now show file size on completion and have improved thumbnail detection logic. * Long-pressing a download item now opens a dialog to rename the file and its associated metadata. * The empty state now includes actions to trigger a manual scan or select a custom folder.
**Player Enhancements:** * **Playback Speed Control:** * Added a button to the player controls to change playback speed (0.25x to 2.0x). * Implemented a "long-press to 2x speed" gesture on the player screen for quick fast-forwarding. * **Improved Seeking:** Double-tap seeking is now cumulative, allowing for rapid consecutive taps to skip further. * **LibVLC Black Screen Fix:** Added a workaround to toggle the video track on resume, fixing an issue where the screen could remain black. * **UI Polish:** The player's seek bar now uses a `LinearWavyProgressIndicator` as its track for a more fluid visual style.
**UI/UX and Refactoring:** * **Material 3 Expressive:** * Migrated the app theme to `MaterialExpressiveTheme` and updated dependencies. * Replaced `LazyRow` with `HorizontalMultiBrowseCarousel` and `HorizontalUncontainedCarousel` on the Home screen and Settings screen for improved scrolling behavior and aesthetics. * Replaced standard `CircularProgressIndicator` with `CircularWavyProgressIndicator` throughout the app for a consistent, modern look. * **Shape and Layout Adjustments:** * Updated `RoundedCornerShape` values for a more refined visual appearance. * Home screen content cards now use `maskClip` for better visual integration within the carousel.
**Build and Dependencies:** * Updated Material 3 dependencies to alpha versions that include the new expressive components (`material3-adaptive-navigation-suite`, `material3-window-size-class`). * Added `androidx.documentfile:documentfile` to support SAF operations for custom download folders. * Removed obsolete build metadata and baseline profiles.

feat: Implement IMDb scraping, redesign Profile screen, and enhance UI
This commit introduces a comprehensive metadata scraping system using IMDb, a complete redesign of the Profile screen with advanced analytics, and significant UI/UX enhancements across the application.
**IMDb Metadata Scraping & Content Enrichment:** * **Deep Scraping Engine:** Implemented a robust, multi-stage scraping system (`ImdbScraper`, `RetrofitClient`) to fetch rich metadata for movies and series. * **Phase 1 (Instant):** Uses the IMDb suggestion API for a "light speed" initial discovery to immediately fetch title, poster, and cast. * **Phase 2 (Background):** Incrementally scrapes and populates detailed information including full plot summaries, user reviews, content ratings (e.g., PG-13, 18+), parental guidance warnings (violence, horror), awards, Metascore, and high-resolution cast member images. * **Dynamic UI Updates:** The `DetailScreen` now updates incrementally as new metadata (plot, cast, reviews) is scraped in the background, providing a progressively richer user experience. * **New Settings:** Added toggles in the settings to enable/disable IMDb scraping and automatic download cover scraping. * **Trailer & Cast Display:** * The `DetailScreen` now displays a "Trailer" button that opens the official trailer on YouTube. * A new horizontal carousel displays cast members with their profile pictures.
**Profile Screen Redesign & Analytics:** * **Complete Overhaul:** Replaced the old profile layout with a modern, data-rich, and responsive `LazyVerticalGrid`. * **Advanced Statistics:** The `ProfileViewModel` now calculates and displays a wide range of new user statistics: * **Content Distribution:** A visual bar shows the ratio of movies, series, and live TV watched. * **User Level:** A gamified level (e.g., "Newbie ", "Binge Master ") is assigned based on total watch time. * **Analytics Cards:** New cards display average session time, content completion rate, and count of unfinished items. * **Responsive Layout:** The grid layout automatically adjusts the number of columns based on screen width for optimal viewing on phones and tablets. * **Flat & Expressive Design:** Migrated to a flatter, card-based design using `MaterialTheme.colorScheme.surfaceContainer` for a cleaner aesthetic.
**UI/UX and Player Enhancements:** * **Expressive Carousels:** * Replaced `LazyRow` on the `HomeScreen` with `HorizontalMultiBrowseCarousel` for a more modern, expressive feel. * A new "Featured" hero carousel is now displayed at the top of the Home screen. * **Player & History:** * Refactored player composables into a dedicated `ui.player` package. * Replaced `LinearProgressIndicator` with `LinearWavyProgressIndicator` in the "Continue Watching" row for a more dynamic look. * Added `minLines = 2` to all content cards to prevent text from jumping during image loading, improving layout stability. * **Downloads Screen Optimization:** * Refactored the `LazyColumn` to flatten the item structure, which improves performance and allows for more fluid entry animations. * Optimized Coil image loading requests with explicit sizing and global crossfade. * Removed toast notifications for scan results.
**Build & Technical Refinements:** * **Dependency Updates:** Added `android-youtube-player` and `jsoup` for trailer playback and web scraping. * **Repository Caching:** `XtreamRepository` now implements a file-based caching layer for movie, series, and live stream lists to improve performance and reduce network calls. * **ProGuard/R8:** Enabled full mode for R8 and added specific rules for `kotlinx.serialization` to ensure proper functionality in release builds. * **Localization:** Added new strings for the IMDb features and cleaned up existing localized strings.
